messages:
Sofia P: FYI NorthGate reports a 10-day slippage on FRA H100 allocation (approx 36 units). Need quick triage: air-expedite vs APAC temporary borrow. Tagging @Raj_M @Lee_H.

Raj M: That's rough. Which customers impacted? Any ability to reassign lower-priority rentals?

Sofia P: Impacting three scheduled onboards (customers X/Y/Z) totaling 20 units; remaining are spare replenishments.

VendorOps (NorthGate): Confirmed. Two paths: 1) Air-expedite from NL hub (3-4 biz days) at +€1,250/unit; 2) APAC temporary borrow (7 biz days prep) with ATA-like docs, brokerage ~€75/unit. Both require RMA map for serial swaps.

Lee H: Depot capacity note: FRA can accept max 10 inbound units/day. If we expedite all at once, we'll overwhelm staging. Recommend splitting into 3 AWBs.

Raj M: Operational suggestion: expedite 12 units for highest-priority onboards, borrow 24 from APAC for the rest. Also tag 4 expedited units as "canary" for burn-in and thermal checks.

customs-bot: Reminder: APAC -> EU temporary import requires return-by date and documented value of €1 on manifest. Broker pre-clear speeds turnaround.

Sofia P: Action items: 1) @VendorOps send expedited quote for 12 units and proposed AWB schedule; 2) Prep APAC manifest for 24 units; 3) Open RMA batch and set status to "partial-swap".

VendorOps (NorthGate): Will send quote and attach manifest within 45m. Creating RMA: RMA-94560.

ops-bot: RMA ticket RMA-94560 created. Assignees: Lee H, Raj M. ETA: 48h.

Lee H: I'll reserve inbound slots and add canary burn-in checklist (firmware, 6hr burn-in, serial reconcile).

Raj M: I'll coordinate customs broker and confirm APAC paperwork. Keep this thread as the single source of truth.

Sofia P: Thanks — please update here as soon as quote and manifest attached.
